newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA'S AFRIBRAND SAYS TO SEEK JSE LISTING.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA'S AFRIBRAND SAYS TO SEEK JSE LISTING.

text.p: South Africa's Afribrand said on Saturday it was raising some 26 million rand in capital preparatory to seeking a listing on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange's stores sector in August.

The company, specialising in marketing and distributing of branded consumer products into lower-end economic markets, said in a statement about 16 million rand would be raised by public subscription and the balance by private placing.
Details of the issue would be released "in a few weeks", Afribrand said.
